pages.text: One building tool earns a mention of its own: $(italic)Quark's$() $(bold)Trowel$().$(br2)Hold it, keep a few related blocks in your hotbar, and place as you normally would — the Trowel lays blocks pulled from across those slots, so a wall of mixed stone (cobble, mossy, cracked, plain) comes out naturally speckled instead of flat. No swapping slots every third block.$(br2)Cheap to craft, and the fastest way to give a big surface the hand-laid look. For the smaller Quark and Supplementaries tools, see $(l:pack_tackle/gadgets)Gadgets$().
pages.title: Builder's Tools
